role: The achievement toast in the top right: unlock ("Achievement get!" over the name) or hint (name over description), a 3 second slide/fade driven by Minecraft.getSystemTime, the achievement's item icon drawn at the left.
scope_reason: The toast is drawn on the pixel-gated overlay path: the oracle's --toasts flag records it in agent mode and the native raster_hud renders it (DEVLOG 2026-09-25 achievements lane).
